contracts.observation_prompt: Extract only factual arguments needed by the kernel. Identify the person and calendar year named in the question. Extract explicit statutory givens saying that an individual is a taxpayer's qualifying child or qualifying relative for a stated taxpayer year. Preserve direction exactly: X being Y's child is not evidence that Y is X's child. Do not infer qualifying status from kinship alone and do not decide whether section 152(b)(1) applies. For each channel, mark resolved only after inspecting the complete supplied facts and extracting its finite set; otherwise mark unknown. An unknown channel is not an empty array. Return nonempty verbatim witnesses from the current facts or question and list any factual uncertainty that prevents faithful extraction.

Extract factual events only; do not decide whether section 63(c)(6)(A) applies. Identify the queried person and year. Represent marriage evidence in a source-native form directed to the relevant individual: closed_interval only when both endpoints are stated; onset_only when only commencement is supported; ongoing_through_close when the text and native case timing support marriage from the stated start through December 31 of the queried year. In particular, 'has/have been married since D' describes onset plus an ongoing state; never turn it into an interval ending on D. Do not extend a state beyond the queried close or another supported endpoint. Extract divorce or separate-maintenance decree evidence similarly. Extract actual separate/not-separate filing statements. Under the shared native interpretation, an expressly allowed itemized deduction amount is an itemized=true event for that person and year; generic income or mere possible eligibility is not. Mark a channel resolved only after inspecting the complete facts and extracting its finite set; unknown is not empty. Return nonempty verbatim current witnesses and state unlowerable or unresolved factual uncertainty.

Extract factual decree evidence only, without deciding whether section 7703(a)(2) applies. Identify the queried person and year. Preserve the direction individual-to-spouse and accept only a decree of divorce or separate maintenance. Use closed_interval only with a supported ending date, effective_through_close only when the text or native case semantics supports that the decree remained effective through December 31 of the queried year, and onset_only when only its effective date is supported. A dated event alone must not be extended arbitrarily into future years. Mark the decree channel resolved only after inspecting all supplied facts and extracting its finite set; otherwise mark it unknown. Return nonempty verbatim current witnesses and describe unresolved or unlowerable factual evidence.

Extract blindness facts only; do not decide whether section 63(f)(2)(A) applies. Identify the queried taxpayer and year, and preserve the subject: a spouse's blindness is not the taxpayer's blindness. Prefer an explicit status at a stated date when supplied. Otherwise extract a supported closed blindness interval or an onset together with its expressly supported persistence. Do not infer that blindness persists indefinitely merely from an onset, and do not extend a status into an arbitrary future year. For each of the status, interval, and onset channels, mark resolved only after inspecting the complete facts and extracting its finite set; unknown is not an empty array. Return nonempty verbatim witnesses from the current facts or question and list any uncertainty or evidence that cannot be normalized without inventing a date.

value.rationale: Use one strict, source-native factual read per kernel, then lower only witnessed facts into the unchanged input ports. Ongoing marriage language is represented through the queried year-end rather than as a fabricated same-day closure or unlimited future interval. Directed dependency assertions remain directed. Unknown channels are omitted and reported unresolved; resolved finite absence is represented by an empty array. No refinements are supplied because the contracts do not manufacture alternative factual worlds merely to exercise the planner.
